overview_description.description:
Bouncer gives a possibility to perform an email verification via API regardless whether it is just one email address or tons of them.

We believe that by providing intelligent email verification we are able to secure uninterrupted communication between Talents and Skills with The Needs.

Our aim is to:
- protect your sender's reputation by sanitizing your email addresses' database,
- ensure continuity of the communication with your customers and partners by catching not-existing email addresses in the moment of their entry,
- maximize reach to your customers and partners by segregating low-quality email addresses from those of a high value.

about_short_description.short_description: The most intelligent email verification, to keep you from bounced back emails.

product.name: Email Verification App
product.description: A platform to clean and verify email lists by checking address validity and quality to reduce bounce rates.

product.name: Email Verification API
product.description: An API providing real-time and batch email validation to integrate email verification into IT systems and applications.

product.name: Bouncer Shield
product.description: A tool to protect signup forms by detecting and blocking invalid, malicious, or fraudulent email addresses and IPs in real time.

product.name: Toxicity Check
product.description: A service that analyzes email lists to identify toxic addresses such as spam traps, complainers, or breached emails using a toxicity scale.

product.name: Deliverability Kit
product.description: A set of tools to test inbox placement, verify email authentication, and monitor blocklists to ensure email delivery success.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Connects Bouncer with various marketing platforms to enable seamless email list verification within existing workflows.
